```python
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(17)

# Generate G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []
adj = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))
            adj[i][j] = adj[j][i] = True

# Start with random partition
np.random.seed(42)  # Different seed for initial partition

# Greedy local search
improved = True
while improved:
    improved = False
    best_gain = 0
    best_vertex = -1
    
    for v in range(n):
        # Calculate gain from flipping vertex v
        current_cut_edges = sum(1 for u in range(n) if adj[v][u] and partition[v] != partition[u])
        new_cut_edges = sum(1 for u in range(n) if adj[v][u] and partition[v] == partition[u])
        gain = new_cut_edges - current_cut_edges
        
        if gain > best_gain:
            best_gain = gain
            best_vertex = v
    
    if best_gain > 0:
        partition[best_vertex] = 1 - partition[best_vertex]
        improved = True
```

```python
import numpy as np
import random

# Set seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(17)
random.seed(17)

# Generate G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []
adjacency = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))
            adjacency[i][j] = 1
            adjacency[j][i] = 1

# Start with a random partition
partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]

# Local search improvement
def count_cut_edges(partition, adjacency):
    cut = 0
    for i in range(len(partition)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(partition)):
            if adjacency[i][j] == 1 and partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut += 1
    return cut

# Greedy improvement: flip vertices that increase the cut
improved = True
while improved:
    improved = False
    current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adjacency)
    
    for v in range(n):
        # Try flipping vertex v
        partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adjacency)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            # Keep the flip
            current_cut = new_cut
            improved = True
        else:
            # Revert the flip
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]

# Multiple random restarts for better solution
best_partition = partition[:]
best_cut = count_cut_edges(best_partition, adjacency)

for restart in range(10):
    # Random restart
    current_partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Local search
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        current_cut = count_cut_edges(current_partition, adjacency)
        
        for v in range(n):
            current_partition[v] = 1 - current_partition[v]
            new_cut = count_cut_edges(current_partition, adjacency)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                current_cut = new_cut
                improved = True
            else:
                current_partition[v] = 1 - current_partition[v]
    
    if current_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = current_cut
        best_partition = current_partition[:]
```
